description: This source file defines the CalendarAccountACLService class, which manages access control for CalendarAccount objects based on user permissions and actions.

classes.name: CalendarAccountACLService
classes.description: A class responsible for determining whether a user has permission to perform specific actions on a CalendarAccount.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the service with a CalendarAccount and User object.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to perform the specified action/view on the CalendarAccount.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is explicitly disallowed.

methods.name: isAllUsersAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is allowed for all users.

methods.name: isAdminAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is allowed for admin users.

methods.name: isOwnerAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is permitted for the owner of the account.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if the action/view is governed by security groups.

methods.name: simplifyAction
methods.description: Converts various action names into simplified, standard actions.
